verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at doc.babylonjs.com (HTTP 200), and a runtime probe shows www.babylonjs.com serves one too. Their contents are a structured index of the framework's topics (setup, scene management, meshes, physics, WebGPU, tooling) that an agent can be pointed at. However, the linked docs pages are client-rendered Next.js with no .md mirrors, which limits how well an agent can follow the index into full content. Missing for 10: markdown/plain-text mirrors of doc pages, evidence of an llms-full.txt or other in-depth agent-oriented docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it.
